note_for_next_ai: The repo is the source of truth, not any handover text. Verify a file exists before trusting a status list. ALWAYS run `git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...origin/<branch>` before committing: the sandbox has been silently reset to an old base more than once. The app is AI ASSistant, NOT a Claude clone - do not reintroduce Claude branding. Nothing fake goes in front of the user: a screen may not exist without working.

03_ai-assistant.status: ACTIVE - the app. Built and verified in the sandbox (tests, typecheck, web build, desktop smoke, two end-to-end checks). NOT yet run on the user's Windows machine.
03_ai-assistant.tech: Electron 40 + electron-vite 5 + Vite 6 + React 19 + TypeScript 5.7 + Tailwind 4 + Vitest 2; yaml for frontmatter; no other runtime dependency

layout.src/main: main process: settings.ts (atomic writes), vault/ (service, routes, files, text, blacklist, zip, errors), api/ (loopback guard + server for future use)
layout.src/preload: index.ts - the ONLY bridge: settings.read/update, vault.chooseFolder
layout.src/renderer/src: components (Sidebar, TitleBar, ChatView, MessageRow, Composer, SettingsView, ArtifactsRail, ArtifactCard/Preview, BrainMark), hooks (useChat, useModels, useVault, useArtifactRewrite, usePersistentState, useDesignTokens, useDismiss), state (appearance, performance, chats, artifactEdits, artifactView), platform/bridge.ts, styles/globals.css
layout.src/shared: lib (capture, chat, inference, markdown, prompts, skills, storage, vault, zip, design-systems/), types.ts
layout.tests: 22 files / 208 tests; tests/pending/ holds three parked suites + README

features_implemented: Real chat against Ollama at 127.0.0.1:11434 with streaming, abort, regenerate, edit-and-resend, branching
Artifacts: extracted from replies, sandboxed preview, code view, version history, ZIP export
Comment mode: append-only rewrite of one artifact at a time with versions
Vault writes: every finished conversation becomes Markdown in the vault, with 09 Activity & Undo appended
Settings as a full window (rail + panes): System, Appearance, Performance, Vault, plus search and per-section Reset
Appearance rewrites the theme tokens themselves (accent, conversation width) and survives reload
Performance: Ollama options from profile presets or custom values, measured against the chosen profile
Vault folder chosen through the main process; missing folders are refused and never replaced

Online providers (Claude/Anthropic, GPT/OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, Grok, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint): off until a key is saved in Settings > Models, key sealed by the machine and never handed to the interface
Cloud models named provider/model and answered through the same /api/ollama/chat address, as the same NDJSON records — one streaming path for local and online alike
Browser preview build that states plainly it is the interface only
known_gaps: The browser extension cannot reach the app yet: the vault API is in-process and no loopback port is open
Agent access (what the local or cloud agent may touch: Vault, Files, Shell, Web, MCP) is not built yet — the keys are in place for it
